title: POST https://api-ar-workshop.bistudio.com/workshop-api/api/v3.0/s2s/assets/download-list
$comment: Observed on 1.8.0.13 on a server configured with one Workshop mod, before its registration: 200, 1519 bytes. This is how a dedicated server resolves the addons it needs - the request is a set of mod ids, the answer is the current version of each with a manifestPath per file, and the content itself then comes from ar-gcp-cdn.bistudio.com (see manifest.schema.json). Note the version split: the binary's own strings say v4, the call a dedicated server makes is v3.0. The download list does not filter by compatibility - the observed mod was built for game version 1.4.0.55 and was served for a 1.8.0.13 server.

assets.description: The addons to resolve, keyed by modId. The value was null in the captured request, which reads as `no particular version, give me the current one`.

response.description: One entry per requested addon, in no guaranteed order. The captured answer has one.

id.description: The revision's own id (1296134 in the capture), not the addon's GUID.

gameVersion.description: The game version the revision was built for. 1.4.0.55 in the capture - the only compatibility hint in the answer, and not a constraint on serving it.

platformCompatibility.description: An 8-bit platform bitmask as text: 11111111 means every platform.

platformCompatibilityValue.description: The same bitmask as a number (255).

version.description: The revision's version string, 1.0.44 in the capture.

totalFileSize.description: The sum of the file sizes: 16630 in the capture, which matches the fragment sizes in the CDN manifests.

accessValue.description: 1 in the capture; presumably the numeric form of the access level.

files.description: The files of the revision, three in the capture: data.pak, resourceDatabase.rdb and addon.gproj.

contentType.description: Observed: application/enfusion-pak, application/enfusion-rdb, application/enfusion-gproj - the strings the binary's Content-Type block carries.

manifestPath.description: The path of this file's manifest under https://ar-gcp-cdn.bistudio.com, e.g. manifest/5533/4ae2/<sha512>/14431. Fetch it to learn the file's fragments.

asset.description: The addon itself, as opposed to the revision being served.

type.description: The binary's EWorkshopItemType also names EWTYPE_WORLD_SAVE, which was not observed here.

owned.description: false for a server that merely downloads it.

gameVersion.description: The game version of the tree as a whole; 1.2.1.169 in the capture, older than the revision's own 1.4.0.55.

dependencies.description: The addons this one needs, empty in the capture. The element shape is presumably the same assetBlock, but that was not observed.
